message.content: {"rules":["A SourceIter implementation must return the same mutable reference from as_inner for its lifetime, unless replaced by a caller.","A caller of SourceIter::as_inner may replace the reference only when iteration has stopped and the caller drops the iterator pipeline after extracting the source.","Iterator adapters implementing SourceIter may rely on the source not changing during iteration, but must not rely on it remaining unchanged in their Drop implementations.","Adapters implementing SourceIter::as_inner relinquish private-only access to their source and may rely only on guarantees based on method receiver types.","Adapters implementing SourceIter::as_inner must uphold the source's public API even when they have access to its internals.","Callers of SourceIter::as_inner must allow the source to be in any state consistent with its public API, including a state in which intervening adapters have consumed more elements than strictly necessary."]}
